en.sayed-ali-raza: Thus, who can have greater rights with him than I during his life or after his death?
Therefore depend on your intelligence and make your intentions pure in fighting your enemy,
because I swear by Him who is such that there is no god but He, that I am on the path of truth and that they (the enemy) are on the misleading path of wrong.
You hear what I say; and I seek Allāh’s forgiveness for myself and for you.
